prompt: What is GitHub and how is it different from Git? What does git clone do, and why would you run git pull before starting work on a shared project?
failureMessage: Your step 2 answer needs a bit more text. Please write 2–4 full sentences (with proper grammar and punctuation) in your own words covering: (1) what GitHub is and how it differs from Git, (2) what git clone does, and (3) why you would run git pull before working on a shared project. Try explaining each idea as you would to a colleague who has not used Git or GitHub before. If in doubt, re-reading the course materials can help.
